timing_boundaries.API: before capture.Begin through SDK return, includes Begin; excludes byte validation and capture.End
timing_boundaries.observer_inclusive: same begin through after validation and capture.End
timing_boundaries.CPU: SDK plus Worker process ticks during each complete finite phase; includes barriers, excludes between-phase dumps and later readback/shutdown
timing_boundaries.taper: 32 callers each complete fixed counts; concurrency tapers as callers finish, first/last finish reported
timing_boundaries.RPC: generated synchronous channel CallMethod span, includes coro request/response serialization and adaptation, not socket-wire-only
timing_boundaries.server: generated-adapter receive/exec/send spans omit pre-adapter queue/parse and post-adapter encode/IO
timing_boundaries.residual: per-call RPC minus server processing, then quantiles; mixed scheduling/adaptation/IO/network, not pure network
timing_boundaries.Set: status every call; distinct seed/warm/measure values and final readback verify final writes, not each individual overwrite
timing_boundaries.sampled_quantiles: empirical preselected sample only, about31 upper-one-percent points per enabled measure; not formal population RPC99
